items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A face that brings tears shows sadness only, which is 哀感 (哀 "sorrow" + 感 "feeling"). 哀歓 is "joys and sorrows" shared over time (哀歓を共にする), so it cannot describe a single sad expression.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: この電車はかいそうだから降りなきゃだめだよ。
items.qr: Kono densha wa kaisou dakara orinakya dame da yo.
items.en: This train is going out of service, so you have to get off.
items.hi: यह ट्रेन सेवा से बाहर (ख़ाली वापस) जा रही है, इसलिए तुम्हें उतरना पड़ेगा।
items.gu: આ ટ્રેન સેવામાંથી બહાર (ખાલી પાછી) જાય છે, એટલે તારે ઊતરવું પડશે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A train or bus that runs without passengers back to the depot is 回送 (the 回送 sign on Japanese trains), as in この電車は回送されます. That is why passengers must get off.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: クリーンキャンペーンの一環として駅前の掃除をした。
items.qr: Kuriin kyanpeen no ikkan to shite ekimae no souji o shita.
items.en: As part of the clean-up campaign, we cleaned the area in front of the station.
items.hi: सफ़ाई अभियान के हिस्से के रूप में हमने स्टेशन के सामने की सफ़ाई की।
items.gu: સફાઈ ઝુંબેશના ભાગરૂપે અમે સ્ટેશન આગળની સફાઈ કરી.

opts.en: one room; one ken (a length unit)

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 一環, 一巻 and 一貫 all share the reading いっかん (see the list). The other options differ by one sound: いっこん, いっけん.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 彼の偉業を称えて記念碑が建てられた。
items.qr: Kare no igyou o tataete kinenhi ga taterareta.
items.en: A monument was put up in honour of his great achievements.
items.hi: उनकी महान उपलब्धियों के सम्मान में एक स्मारक बनाया गया।
items.gu: તેમની મહાન સિદ્ધિઓના માનમાં એક સ્મારક બનાવવામાં આવ્યું.

opts.en: work left by someone who has died

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 偉業 and 遺業 are the いぎょう pair in the list. 異郷 is いきょう (no dakuten), and the other two share only 業 (ぎょう).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 外観は純和風の建築だが、インテリアは洋風だ。
items.qr: Gaikan wa jun-wafuu no kenchiku da ga, interia wa youfuu da.
items.en: From the outside it is a purely Japanese-style building, but the interior is Western.
items.hi: बाहर से यह पूरी तरह जापानी शैली की इमारत है, लेकिन अंदर की सजावट पश्चिमी है।
items.gu: બહારથી આ સંપૂર્ણ જાપાની શૈલીની ઇમારત છે, પણ અંદરની સજાવટ પશ્ચિમી છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 外観 and 概観 are the がいかん pair. The others are near-misses: げかん, かいがん, げっかん.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 会社の権限をすべて息子に委譲して、会長職に退くことにした。
items.qr: Kaisha no kengen o subete musuko ni ijou shite, kaichou-shoku ni shirizoku koto ni shita.
items.en: He decided to hand all his authority in the company to his son and step back to the post of chairman.
items.hi: उन्होंने कंपनी के सारे अधिकार अपने बेटे को सौंपकर चेयरमैन के पद पर पीछे हटने का फ़ैसला किया।
items.gu: તેમણે કંપનીના બધા અધિકાર દીકરાને સોંપીને ચેરમેનના પદ પર ખસી જવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 異常, 異状, 委譲 and 移譲 are all いじょう. The distractors all start with い but continue differently (いけん, いぎょう, いげん).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 父の話はうるさいが一理あるとおもう。
items.qr: Chichi no hanashi wa urusai ga ichiri aru to omou.
items.en: My father's lectures are annoying, but I think he has a point.
items.hi: पिताजी की बातें परेशान करती हैं, पर मुझे लगता है उनमें कुछ सच्चाई है।
items.gu: પપ્પાની વાતો કંટાળાજનક લાગે છે, પણ મને લાગે છે કે તેમાં કંઈક તથ્ય છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 一理 and 一利 are the いちり pair (彼の言うことにも一理ある / 百害あって一利なし). 一両 adds a long ょう: いちりょう. That long-vowel trap returns in pattern IV-3.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 市民税は地域によりかくさがある。
items.qr: Shiminzei wa chiiki ni yori kakusa ga aru.
items.en: Municipal tax differs from region to region.
items.hi: नगर-कर में इलाक़े के हिसाब से अंतर होता है।
items.gu: નગર-કરમાં વિસ્તાર પ્રમાણે તફાવત હોય છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A difference in level between groups (regions, generations, incomes) is 格差, as in 世代間の格差. 較差 is the spread between a highest and a lowest value of one thing, like temperature over a day.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 最近はロボットにかんしんを持つ人が増えた。
items.qr: Saikin wa robotto ni kanshin o motsu hito ga fueta.
items.en: Recently more people have become interested in robots.
items.hi: आजकल रोबोट में दिलचस्पी रखने वाले लोग बढ़ गए हैं।
items.gu: હમણાં રોબોટમાં રસ ધરાવતા લોકો વધ્યા છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 〜に関心を持つ = "be interested in ~" (スポーツへの関心が高い). 感心 is used as 〜に感心する ("be impressed"), not with 持つ, and 歓心 goes with 買う／得る.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 新しい部署に移ってかじゅうな労働から解放された。
items.qr: Atarashii busho ni utsutte kajuu na roudou kara kaihou sareta.
items.en: Moving to a new department freed me from an excessive workload.
items.hi: नए विभाग में जाने से मुझे बहुत ज़्यादा काम के बोझ से छुटकारा मिल गया।
items.gu: નવા વિભાગમાં જવાથી મને વધુ પડતા કામના બોજમાંથી છુટકારો મળ્યો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Only 過重 works as a な-adjective before a noun: 過重な労働／過重な負担 ("too heavy"). 加重 is a する-verb (責任が加重される) and 荷重 is the physical load on a bridge or floor.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 政府は法案の採決をきょうこうした。
items.qr: Seifu wa houan no saiketsu o kyoukou shita.
items.en: The government forced through the vote on the bill.
items.hi: सरकार ने विधेयक पर मतदान ज़बरदस्ती करवा दिया।
items.gu: સરકારે ખરડા પર મતદાન જબરદસ્તીથી કરાવ્યું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) "Do something despite objections or bad conditions" is 〜を強行する (採決を強行する, 登山を強行した). 強硬 describes an attitude (強硬な態度) and is not used as 〜を強硬する.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: この食器はかねつに弱いので扱いに注意してください。
items.qr: Kono shokki wa kanetsu ni yowai node atsukai ni chuui shite kudasai.
items.en: This tableware does not stand up to heating, so please handle it with care.
items.hi: ये बर्तन गरम करने से ख़राब हो सकते हैं, इसलिए सावधानी से इस्तेमाल करें।
items.gu: આ વાસણો ગરમ કરવાથી બગડી શકે છે, એટલે સાવચેતીથી વાપરો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Tableware that "is weak to" something cannot take being heated: 加熱 (heating it on purpose, as in microwaving). 過熱 is something getting too hot or too heated by itself. Options 3 and 4 are read こうねつ, not かねつ.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 一人暮らしなので熱帯魚を飼ってかんしょうすることが楽しみです。
items.qr: Hitorigurashi na node nettaigyo o katte kanshou suru koto ga tanoshimi desu.
items.en: I live alone, so keeping tropical fish and watching them is my pleasure.
items.hi: मैं अकेला रहता हूँ, इसलिए उष्णकटिबंधीय मछलियाँ पालकर उन्हें देखना मेरा शौक़ है।
items.gu: હું એકલો રહું છું, એટલે ઉષ્ણકટિબંધીય માછલીઓ પાળીને તેમને જોવાનો મને શોખ છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Looking at living things for pleasure (fish, flowers, plants) is 観賞, as in 観賞用の植物 / 観賞魚. 鑑賞 is for works of art (音楽・映画・絵画を鑑賞する), where you judge and appreciate quality.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 話がなかなかかくしんに触れない。
items.qr: Hanashi ga nakanaka kakushin ni furenai.
items.en: The talk just won't get to the heart of the matter.
items.hi: बात असली मुद्दे तक पहुँच ही नहीं रही।
items.gu: વાત મૂળ મુદ્દા સુધી પહોંચતી જ નથી.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 核心に触れる／迫る／近づく = "touch on / approach the heart of the matter" (事件の核心に近づく). 核 means "nucleus, core".
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: テスト問題にかいとうする時間が足りなかった。
items.qr: Tesuto mondai ni kaitou suru jikan ga tarinakatta.
items.en: I didn't have enough time to answer the test questions.
items.hi: परीक्षा के प्रश्न हल करने के लिए समय कम पड़ गया।
items.gu: પરીક્ષાના પ્રશ્નો ઉકેલવા માટે સમય ઓછો પડ્યો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Working out the answer to a test or exam problem is 解答 (解 = solve), as in 解答用紙. 回答 replies to a question, survey or inquiry (アンケートに回答する), where there is no right answer to "solve".
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 彼は実力を過小にひょうかされている。
items.qr: Kare wa jitsuryoku o kashou ni hyouka sarete iru.
items.en: His ability is underrated.
items.hi: उसकी क़ाबिलियत को कम आँका जाता है।
items.gu: તેની આવડતને ઓછી આંકવામાં આવે છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 過小, 寡少 and 過少 are the かしょう trio in the list. 過去 shares the kanji 過 but is かこ; 化粧 and 故障 differ by one vowel (けしょう, こしょう).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 我々はその件には関知していません。
items.qr: Wareware wa sono ken ni wa kanchi shite imasen.
items.en: We have nothing to do with that matter.
items.hi: उस मामले से हमारा कोई लेना-देना नहीं है।
items.gu: એ બાબત સાથે અમારે કોઈ લેવાદેવા નથી.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 関知 and 感知 are the かんち pair. 関心 shares the kanji 関 but is かんしん, and 見地 is けんち.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: わたしの家業はうどん屋です。
items.qr: Watashi no kagyou wa udon-ya desu.
items.en: My family business is an udon shop.
items.hi: मेरा पारिवारिक व्यवसाय उडोन (नूडल) की दुकान है।
items.gu: મારો કુટુંબનો ધંધો ઉડોન (નૂડલ)ની દુકાન છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 家業 and 稼業 are the かぎょう pair. All four options end in 業 (ぎょう), so only the first sound decides: か, not い, や or けん.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 子どもを観察していると毎日発見がある。
items.qr: Kodomo o kansatsu shite iru to mainichi hakken ga aru.
items.en: When you watch children closely, you discover something new every day.
items.hi: बच्चों को ध्यान से देखो तो हर दिन कुछ नया पता चलता है।
items.gu: બાળકોને ધ્યાનથી જોઈએ તો રોજ કંઈક નવું જાણવા મળે છે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 観察 and 監察 are the かんさつ pair. 警察 shares 察 but is けいさつ, and options 2 and 4 are made-up compounds.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: サンタクロースの登場に子どもたちは歓声を上げた。
items.qr: Santa Kuroosu no toujou ni kodomotachi wa kansei o ageta.
items.en: The children cheered when Santa Claus appeared.
items.hi: सांता क्लॉज़ के आते ही बच्चे ख़ुशी से चिल्ला उठे।
items.gu: સાન્તાક્લોઝ આવતાં જ બાળકો ખુશીથી બૂમો પાડી ઊઠ્યાં.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 歓声 and 喚声 are the かんせい pair; both go with 上げる. All four options end in 声 (せい), so the first part decides: only 喚 is read かん.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 有名な小説家のこうえんを聞きに行く。
items.qr: Yuumei na shousetsuka no kouen o kiki ni iku.
items.en: I'm going to hear a lecture by a famous novelist.
items.hi: मैं एक प्रसिद्ध उपन्यासकार का व्याख्यान सुनने जा रहा हूँ।
items.gu: હું એક પ્રખ્યાત નવલકથાકારનું વ્યાખ્યાન સાંભળવા જાઉં છું.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A novelist gives a talk, and you "go to hear" (聞きに行く) a talk: 講演 (講 = lecture, as in 講義). 公演 is a play or concert you "see"; 口演 is a storyteller's performance.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: このアパートの台所はきょうどうで使用することになっている。
items.qr: Kono apaato no daidokoro wa kyoudou de shiyou suru koto ni natte iru.
items.en: In this apartment building the kitchen is shared.
items.hi: इस अपार्टमेंट में रसोई सब मिलकर इस्तेमाल करते हैं।
items.gu: આ એપાર્ટમેન્ટમાં રસોડું બધા સાથે મળીને વાપરે છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Sharing a facility is 共同 (共 = together): 共同で使う, 共同トイレ, トイレと風呂は共同だ. 協同 and 協働 are about cooperating on a project, not sharing a room.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: この花はきしょう植物だそうだ。
items.qr: Kono hana wa kishou shokubutsu da sou da.
items.en: I hear this flower is a rare plant.
items.hi: सुना है यह फूल एक दुर्लभ पौधा है।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે આ ફૂલ એક દુર્લભ છોડ છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 希 = rare, 少 = few: 希少植物／希少動物 (rare species). The other three are real words but say nothing about a plant.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: 海岸沿いに機械生産が中心のこうぎょう地帯が続いている。
items.qr: Kaigan-zoi ni kikai seisan ga chuushin no kougyou chitai ga tsuzuite iru.
items.en: An industrial belt centred on machine production stretches along the coast.
items.hi: समुद्र तट के साथ-साथ मशीन उत्पादन वाला औद्योगिक क्षेत्र फैला है।
items.gu: દરિયાકિનારે મશીન ઉત્પાદન પર આધારિત ઔદ્યોગિક વિસ્તાર ફેલાયેલો છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 機械生産 (machine production) is manufacturing: 工業地帯, as in the list. 鉱業 is mining, which does not fit "machine production".
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: 水道のけんしんをしてもらう。
items.qr: Suidou no kenshin o shite morau.
items.en: I have the water meter read.
items.hi: पानी का मीटर पढ़वाता हूँ।
items.gu: પાણીનું મીટર વંચાવું છું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Water, gas and electricity meters are "read" by checking the needle (針): 検針, as in ガスメーターの検針. 健診・検診 are medical.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: きょくち探検にでかける人を応援する。
items.qr: Kyokuchi tanken ni dekakeru hito o ouen suru.
items.en: I support people who set off on polar expeditions.
items.hi: मैं ध्रुवीय अभियान पर जाने वालों का समर्थन करता हूँ।
items.gu: હું ધ્રુવીય અભિયાન પર જનારાઓને ટેકો આપું છું.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) An expedition (探検) goes to a place: the polar regions, 極地 (極 = pole, as in 北極・南極). 局地 is a "local area" (局地的な豪雨), not a destination for explorers.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: きせいの考え方だけでは現状の打破は難しい。
items.qr: Kisei no kangaekata dake de wa genjou no daha wa muzukashii.
items.en: With conventional thinking alone, it's hard to break out of the current situation.
items.hi: सिर्फ़ पुरानी सोच से मौजूदा हालत को बदलना मुश्किल है।
items.gu: માત્ર જૂની વિચારસરણીથી હાલની સ્થિતિ તોડવી મુશ્કેલ છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Ideas and facts that already exist are 既成 (既成の考え方, 既成事実). 既製 is for manufactured products (既製服, 既製品). Both start with 既 ("already"); the second kanji decides: 成 "formed" vs 製 "made".
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: これは上司のけっさいを待っていては間に合わなくなる。
items.qr: Kore wa joushi no kessai o matte ite wa maniawanaku naru.
items.en: If we wait for the boss's approval on this, we'll miss the deadline.
items.hi: इसके लिए बॉस की मंज़ूरी का इंतज़ार किया तो देर हो जाएगी।
items.gu: આ માટે બોસની મંજૂરીની રાહ જોઈશું તો મોડું થઈ જશે.

opts.en: a cry of delight (快哉を叫ぶ)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A superior's sign-off is 決裁 (裁 = judge, decide), as in 社長の決裁を待つ. 決済 is paying or settling an account (現金で決済する). Options 1 and 4 are かいさい, not けっさい.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: 景気の悪い話はしないでくれ
items.qr: Keiki no warui hanashi wa shinaide kure
items.en: Don't tell me gloomy stories.
items.hi: मायूस करने वाली बातें मत करो।
items.gu: નિરાશાજનક વાતો ન કર.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 景気 and 契機 are the けいき pair. 形相 is a trap: 形 is usually けい (形成, 形勢), but in 形相 it is read ぎょう. (added, not in book) 景気の悪い話 literally "a bad-economy story" means any depressing talk.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: この大学がわたしの原点です。
items.qr: Kono daigaku ga watashi no genten desu.
items.en: This university is where I started out.
items.hi: यह विश्वविद्यालय मेरी शुरुआत की जगह है।
items.gu: આ યુનિવર્સિટી મારી શરૂઆતનું સ્થાન છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 原点 and 減点 are the げんてん pair. 点眼 contains 点 but is てんがん, and 天変 is てんぺん.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: ここを基点に考えるとそこまで600kmぐらいだ。
items.qr: Koko o kiten ni kangaeru to soko made roppyaku kiro gurai da.
items.en: Measured from here, it's about 600 km to there.
items.hi: यहाँ से गिनें तो वहाँ तक लगभग 600 किलोमीटर है।
items.gu: અહીંથી ગણીએ તો ત્યાં સુધી લગભગ 600 કિલોમીટર છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 基点 and 起点 are the きてん pair. 原点 has a similar meaning ("starting point") but is read げんてん; the question tests sound, not meaning.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: 彼の巧言にうまくだまされてしまった。
items.qr: Kare no kougen ni umaku damasarete shimatta.
items.en: I was completely taken in by his smooth talk.
items.hi: मैं उसकी चिकनी-चुपड़ी बातों में पूरी तरह फँस गया।
items.gu: હું તેની મીઠી-મીઠી વાતોમાં પૂરેપૂરો ફસાઈ ગયો.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 巧言 and 公言 are both こうげん (the list also has 広言 and 高言). Every option ends in 言 (げん), so only the first sound matters: こう, not きょう, く or しん.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: 決戦は悪天候の中で行われることになった。
items.qr: Kessen wa akutenkou no naka de okonawareru koto ni natta.
items.en: The deciding match ended up being held in bad weather.
items.hi: निर्णायक मुक़ाबला ख़राब मौसम में ही होना तय हुआ।
items.gu: નિર્ણાયક મુકાબલો ખરાબ હવામાનમાં જ યોજાયો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 決戦 and 決選 are the けっせん pair. All four start with 決; 決勝 means nearly the same as 決戦 but is けっしょう.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ③

items.q: 彼は被害者側の人間だからこうせいな判断はできないだろう。
items.qr: Kare wa higaishagawa no ningen da kara kousei na handan wa dekinai darou.
items.en: He is on the victim's side, so he probably can't judge fairly.
items.hi: वह पीड़ित पक्ष का आदमी है, इसलिए शायद निष्पक्ष फ़ैसला नहीं कर पाएगा।
items.gu: તે પીડિત પક્ષનો માણસ છે, એટલે કદાચ નિષ્પક્ષ નિર્ણય નહીં લઈ શકે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Someone who is on one side cannot be impartial: 公正な判断 (公 = public, fair), as in the list. Of the four, only 公正 is a な-adjective; the others are する-nouns.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 来年度より新しい法律がしこうされることになった。
items.qr: Rainendo yori atarashii houritsu ga shikou sareru koto ni natta.
items.en: A new law will come into force from next fiscal year.
items.hi: अगले वित्त वर्ष से नया क़ानून लागू होगा।
items.gu: આવતા નાણાકીય વર્ષથી નવો કાયદો અમલમાં આવશે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Laws and systems are 施行される ("put into effect"), as in 新教育制度が施行される. 施工 shares 施 but is for building work.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: このじきを逃したら二度と事業は興せないだろう。
items.qr: Kono jiki o nogashitara nido to jigyou wa okosenai darou.
items.en: If I miss this opportunity, I'll probably never be able to start the business.
items.hi: यह मौक़ा चूक गया तो शायद फिर कभी व्यवसाय शुरू नहीं कर पाऊँगा।
items.gu: આ તક ચૂકી જઈશ તો કદાચ ફરી ક્યારેય ધંધો શરૂ નહીં કરી શકું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) What you can "miss" (逃す) is a chance: 時機 (機 = opportunity, as in 機会). 時期 is just a period of time. 時宜 is read じぎ.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: ごみのしゅうしゅう車が来る時間に間に合わなかった。
items.qr: Gomi no shuushuusha ga kuru jikan ni maniawanakatta.
items.en: I didn't make it in time for the garbage truck.
items.hi: मैं कूड़ा उठाने वाली गाड़ी के समय तक नहीं पहुँच पाया।
items.gu: કચરો ઉપાડવાની ગાડી આવે ત્યાં સુધી હું પહોંચી ન શક્યો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Collecting garbage is ごみ収集 (収集車 = garbage truck). 収拾 is for "getting a situation under control" (事態を収拾する). Options 3 and 4 swap the kanji order and are not words.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 先週のランチサービスはこうひょうだったので、今週も続けることにした。
items.qr: Senshuu no ranchi saabisu wa kouhyou datta node, konshuu mo tsuzukeru koto ni shita.
items.en: Last week's lunch special was popular, so we decided to keep it this week too.
items.hi: पिछले हफ़्ते की लंच सर्विस लोगों को पसंद आई, इसलिए इस हफ़्ते भी जारी रखने का फ़ैसला किया।
items.gu: ગયા અઠવાડિયાની લંચ સર્વિસ લોકોને ગમી, એટલે આ અઠવાડિયે પણ ચાલુ રાખવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) They kept the lunch special because people liked it: 好評 (好 = liked). Its opposite is 不評. 講評 is a teacher's or judge's critique.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: じてんで船の構造について調べる。
items.qr: Jiten de fune no kouzou ni tsuite shiraberu.
items.en: I look up how ships are built in an encyclopedia.
items.hi: जहाज़ की बनावट के बारे में विश्वकोश में देखता हूँ।
items.gu: વહાણની રચના વિશે જ્ઞાનકોશમાં જોઉં છું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A ship's structure is a "thing" (事), not a word's meaning, so you look it up in a 事典 (百科事典). 辞典 explains words (言葉の意味), 字典 explains characters.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 彼女は自分に能力がないことをじにんしている。
items.qr: Kanojo wa jibun ni nouryoku ga nai koto o jinin shite iru.
items.en: She admits to herself that she lacks the ability.
items.hi: वह ख़ुद मानती है कि उसमें क़ाबिलियत नहीं है।
items.gu: તે પોતે સ્વીકારે છે કે તેનામાં આવડત નથી.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Admitting a weakness or fault is 自認 (認 = admit, as in 認める): 過失を自認する. 自任 is used for a positive self-image ("I see myself as a talented ~"), so it does not fit 能力がない.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 今日のこうていは子どもでも歩けるぐらいの距離なので心配要りません。
items.qr: Kyou no koutei wa kodomo demo arukeru gurai no kyori na node shinpai irimasen.
items.en: Today's route is short enough for even a child to walk, so don't worry.
items.hi: आज का सफ़र इतना ही है कि बच्चा भी चल ले, इसलिए चिंता मत करो।
items.gu: આજની મુસાફરી એટલી જ છે કે બાળક પણ ચાલી શકે, એટલે ચિંતા ન કરો.

opts.en: high and low; ups and downs

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A distance you walk (距離, 歩ける) is 行程 (行 = go), as in 子どもには厳しい行程だ. 工程 is the steps of a work process. All four options are real こうてい words.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 警察に行って新しい運転免許証の交付を受けた。
items.qr: Keisatsu ni itte atarashii unten menkyoshou no koufu o uketa.
items.en: I went to the police and was issued a new driving licence.
items.hi: पुलिस स्टेशन जाकर मुझे नया ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस जारी हुआ।
items.gu: પોલીસ સ્ટેશન જઈને મને નવું ડ્રાઇવિંગ લાઇસન્સ મળ્યું.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 交付 and 公布 are the こうふ pair. 交渉 shares 交 but is こうしょう; 還付 shares 付 but is かんぷ.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 中学校の懐かしい校舎の写真を撮った。
items.qr: Chuugakkou no natsukashii kousha no shashin o totta.
items.en: I took a photo of my dear old junior-high school building.
items.hi: मैंने अपने पुराने मिडिल स्कूल की प्यारी इमारत की फ़ोटो ली।
items.gu: મેં મારી જૂની માધ્યમિક શાળાના વહાલા મકાનનો ફોટો લીધો.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 校舎, 公舎 and 公社 are the こうしゃ trio. 官舎 shares 舎 and even means something similar to 公舎, but it is かんしゃ.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 入社してからずっと広報の仕事をしている。
items.qr: Nyuusha shite kara zutto kouhou no shigoto o shite iru.
items.en: I've worked in public relations ever since I joined the company.
items.hi: कंपनी में आने के बाद से मैं लगातार जनसंपर्क का काम कर रहा हूँ।
items.gu: કંપનીમાં જોડાયો ત્યારથી હું સતત જનસંપર્કનું કામ કરું છું.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 広報 and 公報 are the こうほう pair. The distractors each change one sound: こうぼう (dakuten), ごうほう, かんぽう.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 株式会社とはいいながら実態は家族企業だ。
items.qr: Kabushiki-gaisha to wa iinagara jittai wa kazoku kigyou da.
items.en: It may call itself a joint-stock company, but in reality it's a family business.
items.hi: कहने को यह कंपनी है, पर असल में पारिवारिक कारोबार है।
items.gu: કહેવા પૂરતી આ કંપની છે, પણ ખરેખર કુટુંબનો ધંધો છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 実態 and 実体 are the じったい pair. 実勢 shares 実 but is じっせい; 絶対 rhymes (ぜったい) but starts with ぜ.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: 彼は自分の才能を誇示しすぎるのでみんなに嫌われている。
items.qr: Kare wa jibun no sainou o koji shisugiru node minna ni kirawarete iru.
items.en: He shows off his talents too much, so everyone dislikes him.
items.hi: वह अपनी प्रतिभा का बहुत दिखावा करता है, इसलिए सब उसे नापसंद करते हैं।
items.gu: તે પોતાની પ્રતિભાનો બહુ દેખાડો કરે છે, એટલે બધા તેને નાપસંદ કરે છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 誇示, 固持 and 固辞 are all こじ, with a short こ. 工事 (こうじ) is the long-vowel trap, and 行使 is こうし.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ④

items.q: しゅうとく物はどんな小さなものでも警察に届けた方がよい。
items.qr: Shuutokubutsu wa donna chiisa na mono demo keisatsu ni todoketa hou ga yoi.
items.en: You should hand in anything you find to the police, however small.
items.hi: मिली हुई चीज़ कितनी भी छोटी हो, पुलिस को सौंप देनी चाहिए।
items.gu: મળેલી વસ્તુ ગમે તેટલી નાની હોય, પોલીસને સોંપી દેવી જોઈએ.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 拾 = pick up (拾う), so 拾得物 is something picked up: lost property you hand in to the police (拾得物を届ける).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 子どもを亡くした親のしんじょうはどれほどのものか推し量れない。
items.qr: Kodomo o nakushita oya no shinjou wa dore hodo no mono ka oshihakarenai.
items.en: One cannot imagine what parents who have lost a child must feel.
items.hi: जिन माता-पिता ने अपना बच्चा खोया हो, उनके मन पर क्या बीतती है, इसका अंदाज़ा नहीं लगाया जा सकता।
items.gu: જે માતા-પિતાએ બાળક ગુમાવ્યું હોય, તેમના મન પર શું વીતે છે તેનો અંદાજ ન લગાવી શકાય.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) What others try to imagine (推し量る, 察する) is a person's 心情, their state of mind. 真情 is what someone reveals themselves (真情を吐露する); it stresses sincerity, not grief.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: いとこがスピーチコンテストに出て最優秀賞をじゅしょうした。
items.qr: Itoko ga supiichi kontesuto ni dete saiyuushuushou o jushou shita.
items.en: My cousin entered a speech contest and won first prize.
items.hi: मेरे चचेरे भाई ने भाषण प्रतियोगिता में हिस्सा लेकर सर्वश्रेष्ठ पुरस्कार जीता।
items.gu: મારા પિતરાઈએ વક્તૃત્વ સ્પર્ધામાં ભાગ લઈને શ્રેષ્ઠ ઇનામ જીત્યું.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Two choices here: receive (受) or give (授), and prize (賞) or medal (章). The cousin receives a prize (最優秀賞), so 受 + 賞 = 受賞.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: パーティーのしんこう役はあなたが務めてください。
items.qr: Paatii no shinkouyaku wa anata ga tsutomete kudasai.
items.en: Please act as the MC for the party.
items.hi: पार्टी का संचालन आप कीजिए।
items.gu: પાર્ટીનું સંચાલન તમે કરજો.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) The person who keeps an event moving is the 進行役 or 司会進行, as in 会議の進行を任される.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 新型インフルエンザのしんせいのウイルスが発見された。
items.qr: Shingata infuruenza no shinsei no uirusu ga hakken sareta.
items.en: The genuine virus of the new type of influenza was found.
items.hi: नए प्रकार के इन्फ़्लुएंज़ा का असली वायरस पाया गया।
items.gu: નવા પ્રકારના ઇન્ફ્લુએન્ઝાનો અસલ વાયરસ મળી આવ્યો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) In medicine, 真性 marks a confirmed, true case of a disease (真性のコレラ患者), as opposed to 疑似 (suspected). 真正 is "authentic" for documents, testimony or art.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 彼女は大学をしゅせきで卒業したらしい。
items.qr: Kanojo wa daigaku o shuseki de sotsugyou shita rashii.
items.en: Apparently she graduated top of her class.
items.hi: सुना है वह विश्वविद्यालय में पहले स्थान पर रहकर पास हुई।
items.gu: સાંભળ્યું છે કે તે યુનિવર્સિટીમાં પ્રથમ ક્રમે પાસ થઈ.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 首 = head, first: 首席で卒業する = graduate first in the class. 主席 is a political title (国家主席). 出席 is しゅっせき.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 会社からしようの電話をかけてはいけない。
items.qr: Kaisha kara shiyou no denwa o kakete wa ikenai.
items.en: You must not make personal calls from the office.
items.hi: दफ़्तर से निजी फ़ोन नहीं करने चाहिए।
items.gu: ઑફિસમાંથી અંગત ફોન ન કરવા જોઈએ.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 私 = private: 私用の電話 is a personal call, which you should not make on company time (私用で外に出る).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: このビルは電波のしょうがいがあってうまくテレビ受信ができない。
items.qr: Kono biru wa denpa no shougai ga atte umaku terebi jushin ga dekinai.
items.en: This building has signal interference, so TV reception is poor.
items.hi: इस इमारत में सिग्नल में रुकावट है, इसलिए टीवी ठीक से नहीं आता।
items.gu: આ ઇમારતમાં સિગ્નલમાં અવરોધ છે, એટલે ટીવી બરાબર આવતું નથી.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Something that gets in the way of signals is 障害 (障 = hinder): 電波障害. 傷害 (傷 = wound) is harm done to a person's body.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 台風の進路が変わったのでこの地方は被害を受けなかった。
items.qr: Taifuu no shinro ga kawatta node kono chihou wa higai o ukenakatta.
items.en: The typhoon changed course, so this region escaped damage.
items.hi: तूफ़ान का रास्ता बदल गया, इसलिए इस इलाक़े को नुक़सान नहीं हुआ।
items.gu: વાવાઝોડાનો માર્ગ બદલાયો, એટલે આ વિસ્તારને નુકસાન ન થયું.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 進路 and 針路 are the しんろ pair. 心労 is the long-vowel trap: しんろう.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 助成金によってこの事業は成り立っている。
items.qr: Joseikin ni yotte kono jigyou wa naritatte iru.
items.en: This project runs on subsidies.
items.hi: यह परियोजना अनुदान के सहारे चल रही है।
items.gu: આ પ્રોજેક્ટ અનુદાનના સહારે ચાલે છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 助成 and 助勢 are the じょせい pair. 情勢 is the long-vowel trap (じょうせい), and 書生 drops the dakuten (しょせい).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 駅前に新規開店したレストランはとても人気がある。
items.qr: Ekimae ni shinki kaiten shita resutoran wa totemo ninki ga aru.
items.en: The restaurant that newly opened in front of the station is very popular.
items.hi: स्टेशन के सामने नया खुला रेस्टोरेंट बहुत लोकप्रिय है।
items.gu: સ્ટેશન સામે નવું ખૂલેલું રેસ્ટોરન્ટ બહુ લોકપ્રિય છે.

opts.en: humanity and justice; code of honour

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 新規 and 心機 (in 心機一転) are both しんき. 審議 adds a dakuten (しんぎ), and 仁義 adds two (じんぎ).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 彼は成算があると思って企業買収に取り組んだのだろう。
items.qr: Kare wa seisan ga aru to omotte kigyou baishuu ni torikunda no darou.
items.en: He must have taken on the takeover because he thought it could succeed.
items.hi: उसे सफलता की उम्मीद रही होगी, तभी उसने कंपनी के अधिग्रहण में हाथ डाला।
items.gu: તેને સફળતાની આશા હશે, એટલે જ તેણે કંપની ખરીદવાનું કામ હાથમાં લીધું હશે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 成算, 精算 and 清算 are the せいさん trio. 清掃 shares 清 but is せいそう; 乗算 shares 算 but is じょうざん.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: 男は意味深長な言葉を残して立ち去った。
items.qr: Otoko wa imi shinchou na kotoba o nokoshite tachisatta.
items.en: The man left, leaving behind some meaningful words.
items.hi: वह आदमी कुछ गहरे अर्थ वाले शब्द कहकर चला गया।
items.gu: તે માણસ કંઈક ઊંડા અર્થવાળા શબ્દો કહીને ચાલ્યો ગયો.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 深長 and 慎重 are the しんちょう pair. 心証 differs by one consonant (しんしょう). 意味深長 is a set four-character phrase worth learning whole.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑤

items.q: この薬はそっこう性がある。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa sokkousei ga aru.
items.en: This medicine works immediately.
items.hi: यह दवा तुरंत असर करती है।
items.gu: આ દવા તરત અસર કરે છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) For medicine the standard word is 即効 (即効薬, 即効性), as in the list. 速効 also exists (速効性の肥料) and dictionaries often treat it as a variant, but the book's key wants 即効 here: 効 = effect, so only 即効・速効 are possible, and 即 "instantly" is the normal choice for drugs.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: 壊してしまった家具のほしょうをしなければならない。
items.qr: Kowashite shimatta kagu no hoshou o shinakereba naranai.
items.en: I have to pay compensation for the furniture I broke.
items.hi: जो फ़र्नीचर मैंने तोड़ दिया, उसका मुआवज़ा देना होगा।
items.gu: મેં તોડી નાખેલા ફર્નિચરનું વળતર આપવું પડશે.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Making up for damage you caused is 補償 (補 = make up, 償 = repay), as in 事故の補償金. 報償 is ほうしょう.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: いろいろなせいやくがある中ですばらしい作品が生まれた。
items.qr: Iroiro na seiyaku ga aru naka de subarashii sakuhin ga umareta.
items.en: A wonderful work was born despite many constraints.
items.hi: कई बंदिशों के बीच एक शानदार रचना बनी।
items.gu: ઘણાં બંધનો વચ્ચે એક સરસ કૃતિ સર્જાઈ.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) いろいろな制約がある is the book's own example. 制 = control, limit; the sentence contrasts limits with a great result.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: 変なたいせいで荷物を受け取ったので腰を痛めた。
items.qr: Hen na taisei de nimotsu o uketotta node koshi o itameta.
items.en: I hurt my back because I took the package in an awkward position.
items.hi: अजीब मुद्रा में सामान पकड़ने से मेरी कमर में दर्द हो गया।
items.gu: વિચિત્ર મુદ્રામાં સામાન પકડવાથી મારી કમરમાં દુખાવો થયો.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) A posture that hurts your back is about the body: 体勢 (体 = body, 勢 = force), as in 体勢が崩れて転んだ. 態勢 is organisational readiness (受け入れ態勢).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: へいこう感覚が崩れて転んでしまった。
items.qr: Heikou kankaku ga kuzurete koronde shimatta.
items.en: I lost my sense of balance and fell over.
items.hi: मेरा संतुलन बिगड़ गया और मैं गिर पड़ा।
items.gu: મારું સંતુલન ખોરવાયું અને હું પડી ગયો.

opts.en: going side by side (variant of 並行)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 平衡感覚 = sense of balance (衡 = scales). The other three are all about lines or things running side by side.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: この注射のたいしょうは年少者と高齢者です。
items.qr: Kono chuusha no taishou wa nenshousha to koureisha desu.
items.en: This injection is for young people and the elderly.
items.hi: यह टीका बच्चों और बुज़ुर्गों के लिए है।
items.gu: આ ઇન્જેક્શન બાળકો અને વૃદ્ધો માટે છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) The people something is aimed at are its 対象 (対象者, 対象年齢). 対症 is a medical-sounding trap, but it only appears in 対症療法.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: あくまでも世界平和をついきゅうするために活動したい。
items.qr: Akumademo sekai heiwa o tsuikyuu suru tame ni katsudou shitai.
items.en: I want to keep working, whatever happens, in pursuit of world peace.
items.hi: मैं हर हाल में विश्व-शांति की खोज के लिए काम करना चाहता हूँ।
items.gu: હું ગમે તે થાય, વિશ્વશાંતિની શોધ માટે કામ કરવા માગું છું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Chasing a goal you want (利益, 幸福, 平和) is 追求 (求 = seek). 追究 digs into truth or causes; 追及 presses someone over responsibility.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: そくせいで栽培された野菜の栄養価は大丈夫だろうか。
items.qr: Sokusei de saibai sareta yasai no eiyouka wa daijoubu darou ka.
items.en: I wonder if force-grown vegetables are still nutritious.
items.hi: जल्दी उगाई गई सब्ज़ियों में पोषण ठीक रहता होगा क्या?
items.gu: ઝડપથી ઉગાડેલાં શાકભાજીમાં પોષણ બરાબર હશે ખરું?
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 促成栽培 is the fixed term for forcing crops to grow early (促 = urge on). 速成 is for training people quickly (速成講座).
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: 直感で彼がウソをついていることが分かった。
items.qr: Chokkan de kare ga uso o tsuite iru koto ga wakatta.
items.en: I knew by instinct that he was lying.
items.hi: मुझे अंदर से महसूस हो गया कि वह झूठ बोल रहा है।
items.gu: મને અંદરથી સમજાઈ ગયું કે તે ખોટું બોલે છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 直感 and 直観 are the ちょっかん pair. 長官 swaps the small っ for a long う (ちょうかん), and 直径 shares 直 but ends in けい.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: 年齢を明記してください。
items.qr: Nenrei o meiki shite kudasai.
items.en: Please state your age clearly.
items.hi: कृपया अपनी उम्र साफ़-साफ़ लिखें।
items.gu: કૃપા કરીને તમારી ઉંમર સ્પષ્ટ લખો.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 明記 and 銘記 are the めいき pair. The other three are not words that are read めいき, so this one is easy once you know 銘 = めい.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: どうしても乗りたい電車だったので必死に走った。
items.qr: Doushitemo noritai densha datta node hisshi ni hashitta.
items.en: I really needed to catch that train, so I ran for all I was worth.
items.hi: वह ट्रेन मुझे हर हाल में पकड़नी थी, इसलिए मैं जी-जान से दौड़ा।
items.gu: એ ટ્રેન મારે ગમે તેમ પકડવી હતી, એટલે હું જીવ પર આવીને દોડ્યો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 必死 and 必至 are the ひっし pair. 皮脂 has no small っ: ひし.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: パーティーの会費は会場受付で徴収します。
items.qr: Paatii no kaihi wa kaijou uketsuke de choushuu shimasu.
items.en: The party fee will be collected at the reception desk.
items.hi: पार्टी का शुल्क कार्यक्रम-स्थल के रिसेप्शन पर लिया जाएगा।
items.gu: પાર્ટીની ફી સ્થળ પરના રિસેપ્શન પર લેવામાં આવશે.

opts.en: not a word as written (見納め = みおさめ)

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 徴収 and 徴集 are the ちょうしゅう pair. 聴取 is the trap: ちょうしゅ, with a short final vowel.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: 誰か分からない不審な電話がかかってきた。
items.qr: Dare ka wakaranai fushin na denwa ga kakatte kita.
items.en: I got a suspicious call from someone I didn't know.
items.hi: किसी अनजान व्यक्ति का संदिग्ध फ़ोन आया।
items.gu: કોઈ અજાણ્યા વ્યક્તિનો શંકાસ્પદ ફોન આવ્યો.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 不審 and 不信 are the ふしん pair. 無心 swaps 不 (ふ) for 無 (む); 無 is also ぶ in 無事, which shows why a shared kanji is no guide.
items.unit: I-1 読み方が同じもの ⑥

items.q: 過ちを犯しても、時が過ぎれば忘れてしまうものだ。
items.qr: Ayamachi o okashite mo, toki ga sugireba wasurete shimau mono da.
items.en: Even when you make a mistake, once time passes you tend to forget it.
items.hi: ग़लती हो भी जाए, तो समय बीतने पर इंसान उसे भूल ही जाता है।
items.gu: ભૂલ થઈ જાય તો પણ, સમય વીતે એટલે માણસ તેને ભૂલી જ જાય છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book's 解き方, p.20). Book's 解き方 (paraphrased): when 過 is followed by the okurigana ち, it is read あやまち. (added, not in book) 過ちを犯す ("commit a mistake") is a fixed collocation.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 過ちを犯しても、時が過ぎれば忘れてしまうものだ。
items.qr: Ayamachi o okashite mo, toki ga sugireba wasurete shimau mono da.
items.en: (same sentence) … once time passes you tend to forget it.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … समय बीतने पर इंसान भूल जाता है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … સમય વીતે એટલે માણસ ભૂલી જાય છે.

opts.en: key (鍵) — not a reading of 過

items.why: Answer 2 (book's 解き方, p.20). Book's 解き方 (paraphrased): with the okurigana ぎる, 過 is read すぎる. (added, not in book) Here it appears in the conditional 過ぎれば.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 10年ぶりに先生に会って懐かしかった。
items.qr: Juunen-buri ni sensei ni atte natsukashikatta.
items.en: Meeting my teacher for the first time in ten years brought back fond memories.
items.hi: दस साल बाद अपने शिक्षक से मिलकर पुरानी यादें ताज़ा हो गईं।
items.gu: દસ વર્ષ પછી શિક્ષકને મળીને જૂની યાદો તાજી થઈ ગઈ.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) All four options are 〜かしい adjectives, so the okurigana alone does not decide. 懐 with 〜かしい is なつかしい (懐かしい友達 in the list), and seeing an old teacher after ten years fits that meaning.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 氷の上を滑らかにそして軽やかに滑った。
items.qr: Koori no ue o nameraka ni soshite karoyaka ni subetta.
items.en: I skated over the ice smoothly and lightly.
items.hi: मैं बर्फ़ पर सहजता से और हल्के-फुल्के ढंग से फिसला।
items.gu: હું બરફ પર સરળતાથી અને હળવેથી સરક્યો.

opts.en: not a word (あざやか = vivid)

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 滑 + らか = なめらか. The same kanji with る is すべる (item 4), so this one sentence tests both readings of 滑.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 氷の上を滑らかにそして軽やかに滑った。
items.qr: Koori no ue o nameraka ni soshite karoyaka ni subetta.
items.en: (same sentence) … and lightly.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … और हल्के-फुल्के ढंग से।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … અને હળવેથી.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) All four end in 〜やか, so you need to know the stem: 軽 is かろ in 軽やか (not かる as in 軽い).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 氷の上を滑らかにそして軽やかに滑った。
items.qr: Koori no ue o nameraka ni soshite karoyaka ni subetta.
items.en: (same sentence) … I slid / skated over the ice.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … मैं बर्फ़ पर फिसला।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … હું બરફ પર સરક્યો.

opts.en: 舞った = danced; 待った = waited

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 滑る → 滑った (すべった), as in 氷の上を滑る. こおった is a trap linked to 氷 (ice) in the same sentence.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 人を陥れようとして、自分が悪い状態に陥ってしまった。
items.qr: Hito o otoshiireyou to shite, jibun ga warui joutai ni ochiitte shimatta.
items.en: He tried to trap someone else and ended up in a bad situation himself.
items.hi: उसने किसी और को फँसाने की कोशिश की और ख़ुद ही बुरी हालत में फँस गया।
items.gu: તેણે બીજાને ફસાવવાનો પ્રયત્ન કર્યો અને પોતે જ ખરાબ હાલતમાં ફસાઈ ગયો.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 陥 + れる with an object (人を) is the transitive verb おとしいれる; 陥れようとして is its volitional form. Think 落とし + 入れる ("drop someone in").
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 人を陥れようとして、自分が悪い状態に陥ってしまった。
items.qr: Hito o otoshiireyou to shite, jibun ga warui joutai ni ochiitte shimatta.
items.en: (same sentence) … he himself fell into a bad situation.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … वह ख़ुद बुरी हालत में पड़ गया।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … તે પોતે ખરાબ હાલતમાં પડી ગયો.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 陥 + る with 〜に (状態に) is the intransitive おちいる; its て-form is おちいって (五段 verb, like スランプに陥る).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 本物だと偽って、偽の商品を買わせた。
items.qr: Honmono da to itsuwatte, nise no shouhin o kawaseta.
items.en: They lied that it was genuine and made people buy fake goods.
items.hi: असली बताकर उन्होंने लोगों से नक़ली सामान ख़रीदवाया।
items.gu: અસલી કહીને તેમણે લોકોને નકલી માલ ખરીદાવ્યો.

opts.en: not a word (騙して = だまして)

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 偽 + る = いつわる (名前を偽る); 〜だと偽って = "falsely claiming that ~". Options 1–2 borrow the meaning (lie, deceive) but are not readings of 偽.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 本物だと偽って、偽の商品を買わせた。
items.qr: Honmono da to itsuwatte, nise no shouhin o kawaseta.
items.en: (same sentence) … made people buy fake goods.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … नक़ली सामान ख़रीदवाया।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … નકલી માલ ખરીદાવ્યો.

opts.en: 嘘 = lie (not a reading of 偽)

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) With no okurigana and 〜の before a noun, 偽 is にせ (偽のお金, 偽物). The sentence uses both readings of 偽 side by side.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 私のためにわざわざ時間をさいてくださり、ありがとうございました。
items.qr: Watashi no tame ni wazawaza jikan o saite kudasari, arigatou gozaimashita.
items.en: Thank you for taking the time out especially for me.
items.hi: मेरे लिए ख़ास तौर पर समय निकालने के लिए धन्यवाद।
items.gu: મારા માટે ખાસ સમય કાઢવા બદલ આભાર.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 時間を割く (さく) = "make time", as in the list. 割 with る is わる; with く it is さく. None of the other kanji is read さいて.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: からのビンは、部屋のそとに置いてください。
items.qr: Kara no bin wa, heya no soto ni oite kudasai.
items.en: Please put empty bottles outside the room.
items.hi: ख़ाली बोतलें कमरे के बाहर रख दीजिए।
items.gu: ખાલી બાટલીઓ રૂમની બહાર મૂકી દો.
items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 空のビン = an empty bottle (book example). 空 has three readings in the list: あく (verb), から (empty), そら (sky).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: からのビンは、部屋のそとに置いてください。
items.qr: Kara no bin wa, heya no soto ni oite kudasai.
items.en: (same sentence) … outside the room.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … कमरे के बाहर।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … રૂમની બહાર.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 部屋の外 (そと), as in the list. Remember 外 also reads ほか (外の人) and はずれる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: おどされて契約をむすんでしまった。
items.qr: Odosarete keiyaku o musunde shimatta.
items.en: I was threatened into signing the contract.
items.hi: धमकाए जाने पर मैंने अनुबंध कर लिया।
items.gu: ધમકાવવામાં આવતાં મેં કરાર કરી લીધો.

opts.en: not a verb form (迫られ = せまられ)

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) The standard (常用) kanji for おどす is 脅 (人を脅す). 威す is an older spelling you may meet in literature, but it is not the 常用 reading, so it is not accepted in the exam.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: おどされて契約をむすんでしまった。
items.qr: Odosarete keiyaku o musunde shimatta.
items.en: (same sentence) … I ended up concluding the contract.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … मैंने अनुबंध कर लिया।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … મેં કરાર કરી લીધો.

opts.en: not a verb form (締める = しめる)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 契約を結ぶ / 条約を結ぶ = "conclude a contract / treaty" (book example: 条約を結ぶ). 締結 (ていけつ) means the same, which is why 締 is a tempting trap, but 締 is never read むすぶ.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ①

items.q: 教会の厳かなムードに、思わず目が潤んだ。
items.qr: Kyoukai no ogosoka na muudo ni, omowazu me ga urunda.
items.en: The solemn mood of the church brought tears to my eyes before I knew it.
items.hi: चर्च के गंभीर माहौल में अनायास ही मेरी आँखें नम हो गईं।
items.gu: ચર્ચના ગંભીર વાતાવરણમાં અજાણતાં જ મારી આંખો ભીની થઈ ગઈ.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 厳 + か = おごそか (厳かな雰囲気). しめやか also means "solemn" and fits the meaning, but it is never written 厳か; that is the trap.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 教会の厳かなムードに、思わず目が潤んだ。
items.qr: Kyoukai no ogosoka na muudo ni, omowazu me ga urunda.
items.en: (same sentence) … my eyes filled with tears.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … मेरी आँखें नम हो गईं।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … મારી આંખો ભીની થઈ ગઈ.

opts.en: 産んだ = gave birth; 膿んだ = festered

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 目が潤む is the book's example. With む the reading is うるむ; with う it would be うるおう.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 彼は若者と交わらないので、考え方が後れている。
items.qr: Kare wa wakamono to majiwaranai node, kangaekata ga okurete iru.
items.en: He doesn't mix with young people, so his thinking is behind the times.
items.hi: वह नौजवानों से मेलजोल नहीं रखता, इसलिए उसकी सोच पिछड़ी हुई है।
items.gu: તે યુવાનો સાથે હળતો-મળતો નથી, એટલે તેની વિચારસરણી પછાત છે.

opts.en: 関わる = be involved (not 交)

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 交 + わる = まじわる ("associate with people"; also 道が交わる). かかわらない fits the meaning, but its kanji is 関.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 彼は若者と交わらないので、考え方が後れている。
items.qr: Kare wa wakamono to majiwaranai node, kangaekata ga okurete iru.
items.en: (same sentence) … his thinking is behind the times.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … उसकी सोच पिछड़ी हुई है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … તેની વિચારસરણી પછાત છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 後 + れる = おくれる ("lag behind", as in 流行に後れる). The fakes glue れる onto 後's other readings あと, のち, うし(ろ).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 細かい用事が重なって、いそがしかった。
items.qr: Komakai youji ga kasanatte, isogashikatta.
items.en: Lots of small errands piled up and I was busy.
items.hi: कई छोटे-मोटे काम एक साथ आ गए, इसलिए मैं व्यस्त था।
items.gu: ઘણાં નાનાં-મોટાં કામ ભેગાં થઈ ગયાં, એટલે હું વ્યસ્ત હતો.

opts.en: not a word (細やか = こまやか)
not a reading of 細かい

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 細 + かい = こまかい; 細 + い = ほそい. ほそかい mixes the two.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 細かい用事が重なって、いそがしかった。
items.qr: Komakai youji ga kasanatte, isogashikatta.
items.en: (same sentence) … errands piled up.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … काम एक साथ आ गए।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … કામ ભેગાં થઈ ગયાં.

opts.en: 連なる = stretch in a line (not 重)

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 重 + なる = かさなる (喜びが重なる); 重 + い = おもい.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 国を治める力は、兄のほうが勝っている。
items.qr: Kuni o osameru chikara wa, ani no hou ga masatte iru.
items.en: When it comes to the ability to govern the country, the elder brother is superior.
items.hi: देश पर शासन करने की क्षमता में बड़ा भाई बेहतर है।
items.gu: દેશ પર શાસન કરવાની ક્ષમતામાં મોટો ભાઈ ચડિયાતો છે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 国を治める (book example). With める, 治 is おさめる; with る it is なおる (病気が治る).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 国を治める力は、兄のほうが勝っている。
items.qr: Kuni o osameru chikara wa, ani no hou ga masatte iru.
items.en: (same sentence) … the elder brother is superior.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … बड़ा भाई बेहतर है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … મોટો ભાઈ ચડિયાતો છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Here the okurigana (って) fits both かつ and まさる, so meaning decides: comparing ability (〜のほうが) with ている describes a lasting state of being better, which is まさっている (力が勝る). かっている would mean "is winning" a contest. すぐれて fits the meaning but its kanji is 優.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 外国の人にまじって勉強するのははじめてです。
items.qr: Gaikoku no hito ni majitte benkyou suru no wa hajimete desu.
items.en: It's my first time studying alongside people from other countries.
items.hi: विदेशियों के साथ मिलकर पढ़ाई करने का यह मेरा पहला मौक़ा है।
items.gu: વિદેશીઓ સાથે ભળીને ભણવાનો આ મારો પહેલો અનુભવ છે.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 混じって is a real word too, so this is a nuance question. 交じる is used when the parts stay distinct, as people in a group do (子どもに交じって遊ぶ). 混じる is used when things blend and cannot be separated (水に油が混じる).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 外国の人にまじって勉強するのははじめてです。
items.qr: Gaikoku no hito ni majitte benkyou suru no wa hajimete desu.
items.en: (same sentence) … it's my first time.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … यह पहली बार है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … આ પહેલી વાર છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) "For the first time" (〜のは初めてです) is 初めて. 始めて is only the て-form of the verb 始める ("start doing"), e.g. 勉強を始めて3年.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: ここにあつまっている人たちは、きびしい訓練をしてきた人たちだ。
items.qr: Koko ni atsumatte iru hitotachi wa, kibishii kunren o shite kita hitotachi da.
items.en: The people gathered here have all been through hard training.
items.hi: यहाँ इकट्ठा हुए लोग कड़ा प्रशिक्षण लेकर आए हैं।
items.gu: અહીં ભેગા થયેલા લોકો કડક તાલીમ લઈને આવ્યા છે.

opts.en: not a word (群がって = むらがって)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) あつまる is written 集まる (also つどう: 若者が集う). 群 means a crowd too, but its verbs are むれる and むらがる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: ここにあつまっている人たちは、きびしい訓練をしてきた人たちだ。
items.qr: Koko ni atsumatte iru hitotachi wa, kibishii kunren o shite kita hitotachi da.
items.en: (same sentence) … hard / strict training.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … कड़ा प्रशिक्षण।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … કડક તાલીમ.

opts.en: non-standard spelling of 恐ろしい

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) きびしい = 厳しい (厳しい先生). The same kanji with か is おごそか (item 1).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 手術をこころみたが、このきずをなおすことはできなかった。
items.qr: Shujutsu o kokoromita ga, kono kizu o naosu koto wa dekinakatta.
items.en: They attempted surgery, but could not heal this wound.
items.hi: ऑपरेशन की कोशिश की गई, पर यह घाव ठीक नहीं हो सका।
items.gu: ઑપરેશનનો પ્રયાસ કર્યો, પણ આ ઘા મટાડી ન શકાયો.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 試 + みる = こころみる (脱出を試みる); 試 + す = ためす. 心見た copies the sound こころ + みた but is not a word.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 手術をこころみたが、このきずをなおすことはできなかった。
items.qr: Shujutsu o kokoromita ga, kono kizu o naosu koto wa dekinakatta.
items.en: (same sentence) … could not heal this wound.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … यह घाव ठीक नहीं हो सका।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … આ ઘા મટાડી ન શકાયો.

opts.en: not a word (納める = おさめる)
not standard (修める = おさめる)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) Healing an injury or illness is 治す (病気・傷を治す). Fixing a broken thing is 直す; both are なおす, but only 治す is offered here.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ②

items.q: 自分の行いを省みて、先生に教えを請う。
items.qr: Jibun no okonai o kaerimite, sensei ni oshie o kou.
items.en: Reflecting on my own conduct, I ask my teacher for guidance.
items.hi: अपने आचरण पर आत्मचिंतन करके, मैं शिक्षक से मार्गदर्शन माँगता हूँ।
items.gu: પોતાના વર્તન પર આત્મચિંતન કરીને, હું શિક્ષક પાસે માર્ગદર્શન માગું છું.

opts.en: 試みて = trying — not a reading of 省
opts.hi: कोशिश करके — 省 का उच्चारण नहीं

opts.en: 省みる = to reflect on oneself
not a word (省く is はぶく)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 省 + みる = かえりみる (自分を省みる in the list). 省 + く would be はぶく; option 4 wrongly glues はぶ- onto -みる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 自分の行いを省みて、先生に教えを請う。
items.qr: Jibun no okonai o kaerimite, sensei ni oshie o kou.
items.en: (same sentence) … I ask my teacher for guidance.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … शिक्षक से मार्गदर्शन माँगता हूँ।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … શિક્ષક પાસે માર્ગદર્શન માગું છું.

opts.en: 問う = to ask (a question) — not a reading of 請
請う = to beg, ask for

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 請 + う = こう; 教えを請う is a set phrase ("ask to be taught"). 請 + ける would be うける (仕事を請ける). とう (問う) is a meaning-alike trap.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 彼は優れた科学者であると同時に、優しい父親でもある。
items.qr: Kare wa sugureta kagakusha de aru to douji ni, yasashii chichioya de mo aru.
items.en: He is an outstanding scientist and, at the same time, a kind father.
items.hi: वह एक उत्कृष्ट वैज्ञानिक होने के साथ-साथ एक दयालु पिता भी हैं।
items.gu: તેઓ ઉત્કૃષ્ટ વૈજ્ઞાનિક હોવાની સાથે સાથે દયાળુ પિતા પણ છે.

opts.en: not a standard word (勝る = まさる)
not a word (ゆう is the on-reading of 優)

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 優 + れる = すぐれる; 優れた人材 is the book's example. Option 4 builds a verb from the on-reading ゆう (優秀), which never takes okurigana.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 彼は優れた科学者であると同時に、優しい父親でもある。
items.qr: Kare wa sugureta kagakusha de aru to douji ni, yasashii chichioya de mo aru.
items.en: (same sentence) … a kind father.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … एक दयालु पिता।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … દયાળુ પિતા.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) All four end in 〜しい, so the okurigana does not help; you must know that 優 + しい = やさしい. The sentence uses both readings of 優 (すぐれる / やさしい).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 命令に背いたものは、速やかに申し出ること。
items.qr: Meirei ni somuita mono wa, sumiyaka ni moushideru koto.
items.en: Anyone who disobeyed the order must come forward promptly.
items.hi: जिसने भी आदेश का उल्लंघन किया है, वह तुरंत सामने आए।
items.gu: જેણે પણ હુકમનું ઉલ્લંઘન કર્યું હોય, તે તરત આગળ આવે.

opts.en: 急いた = hurried — not a reading of 背 + いた
opts.hi: जल्दी की — 背 का उच्चारण नहीं

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 背 + く = そむく; 命令に背く is the book's example. せ/せい are readings of 背 alone (背が高い), not of the verb.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 命令に背いたものは、速やかに申し出ること。
items.qr: Meirei ni somuita mono wa, sumiyaka ni moushideru koto.
items.en: (same sentence) … must come forward promptly.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … तुरंत सामने आए।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … તરત આગળ આવે.
items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 速 has two kun stems: はや- (速い, 速める) and すみ- (速やか). Option 3 wrongly uses はや- with 〜やか.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 頼もしい人たちが、メンバーに名を連ねていた。
items.qr: Tanomoshii hitotachi ga, menbaa ni na o tsuranete ita.
items.en: Reliable people were among the names on the member list.
items.hi: भरोसेमंद लोग सदस्यों की सूची में शामिल थे।
items.gu: ભરોસાપાત્ર લોકો સભ્યોની યાદીમાં સામેલ હતા.

opts.en: not a word (mixes 頼る たよる)
not a standard word (勇ましい = いさましい)
not a word (らい is the on-reading)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 頼もしい takes the stem of 頼む (たの-), not of 頼る (たよ-). Option 1 is the trap for learners who only know 頼る.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 頼もしい人たちが、メンバーに名を連ねていた。
items.qr: Tanomoshii hitotachi ga, menbaa ni na o tsuranete ita.
items.en: (same sentence) … had their names listed among the members.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … सदस्यों में उनके नाम शामिल थे।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … સભ્યોમાં તેમનાં નામ સામેલ હતાં.

opts.en: not a word (続けて = つづけて)
not a standard form (阿る おもねる → おもねって)
連ねる = to line up, list

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 名を連ねる = "to have one's name on a list (as a member)". It is the transitive partner of 連なる (山々が連なる in the list); 連 + れる would be つれる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: なまける人は、おことわりです。
items.qr: Namakeru hito wa, okotowari desu.
items.en: Lazy people are not welcome.
items.hi: आलसी लोगों का यहाँ स्वागत नहीं है।
items.gu: આળસુ લોકોનું અહીં સ્વાગત નથી.

opts.en: to go senile; to be absent-minded
not a standard word (遅れる = おくれる)
not a standard word (惰 appears in 怠惰 たいだ)

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) なまける is written 怠ける (仕事を怠ける in the list). 惰 is tempting because 怠惰 means "laziness", but it has no kun reading.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: なまける人は、おことわりです。
items.qr: Namakeru hito wa, okotowari desu.
items.en: (same sentence) … are not welcome / refused.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … मना है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … મનાઈ છે.
items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) お断り(です) = "we refuse / not allowed", from 断る (依頼を断る). 断 + つ is たつ (酒を断つ), so the okurigana again decides the reading.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 彼は何かにあやつられているようにピアノをひいている。
items.qr: Kare wa nanika ni ayatsurarete iru you ni piano o hiite iru.
items.en: He plays the piano as if something were controlling him.
items.hi: वह ऐसे पियानो बजा रहा है मानो कोई चीज़ उसे चला रही हो।
items.gu: તે એવી રીતે પિયાનો વગાડે છે જાણે કોઈ વસ્તુ તેને ચલાવી રહી હોય.

opts.en: not a standard form (指される = さされる)

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) あやつる is 操る (人形を操る); here in the passive 操られる, "be worked like a puppet".
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 彼は何かにあやつられているようにピアノをひいている。
items.qr: Kare wa nanika ni ayatsurarete iru you ni piano o hiite iru.
items.en: (same sentence) … he is playing the piano.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … वह पियानो बजा रहा है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … તે પિયાનો વગાડે છે.

opts.en: not a standard form (演じる = えんじる)

opts.gu: ખેંચવું — એ જ ધ્વનિ, ખોટો અર્થ

opts.en: not a standard form (奏でる = かなでる)

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) ピアノを弾く (book example) — "play" a keyboard or string instrument is 弾く. 引く (pull, draw) has the same sound ひく, which is why it is the strongest trap; 演 and 奏 match the meaning but are never read ひく.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: あのいまわしい事件が、心にしみて忘れられない。
items.qr: Ano imawashii jiken ga, kokoro ni shimite wasurerarenai.
items.en: That horrible incident has sunk deep into my heart and I cannot forget it.
items.hi: वह भयानक घटना मन में गहरी बैठ गई है और भुलाई नहीं जाती।
items.gu: તે ભયાનક ઘટના મનમાં ઊંડી ઊતરી ગઈ છે અને ભુલાતી નથી.

opts.en: not a standard word (勇ましい = いさましい)
not a standard word (紛らわしい = まぎらわしい)

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) いまわしい is 忌まわしい (忌まわしい過去 in the list). The other three borrow kanji from real 〜しい adjectives (勇ましい, 紛らわしい, 難しい) but with the wrong okurigana.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: あのいまわしい事件が、心にしみて忘れられない。
items.qr: Ano imawashii jiken ga, kokoro ni shimite wasurerarenai.
items.en: (same sentence) … has sunk deep into my heart.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … मन में गहरी बैठ गई है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … મનમાં ઊંડી ઊતરી ગઈ છે.

opts.en: not a standard form (透ける = すける)

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 心に染みる = "to touch / sink into the heart", the figurative use of 汗が染みる (list). All four options end in 〜みて, so you must know the stem: 染 + みる = しみる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ③

items.q: 緊張が緩み、和やかなムードになった。
items.qr: Kinchou ga yurumi, nagoyaka na muudo ni natta.
items.en: The tension eased and the mood became friendly.
items.hi: तनाव कम हुआ और माहौल सौहार्दपूर्ण हो गया।
items.gu: તણાવ ઓછો થયો અને વાતાવરણ સૌહાર્દપૂર્ણ બની ગયું.

opts.en: 和み = relaxing (written 和, not 緩)
opts.hi: सहज होना (和 से लिखा जाता है)

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 緊張が緩む is the book's example; here it is the 連用形 緩み used to join two clauses. なごみ fits the mood of the sentence but belongs to 和, which is the next item.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 緊張が緩み、和やかなムードになった。
items.qr: Kinchou ga yurumi, nagoyaka na muudo ni natta.
items.en: (same sentence) … the mood became friendly.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … माहौल सौहार्दपूर्ण हो गया।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … વાતાવરણ સૌહાર્દપૂર્ણ બની ગયું.
items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 和やかなムード is word for word the book's example. All four options end in 〜やか, and ゆるやか is planted because 緩 appears earlier in the same sentence.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 苦い薬ほど病に効くといいます。
items.qr: Nigai kusuri hodo yamai ni kiku to iimasu.
items.en: They say the more bitter the medicine, the better it works on illness.
items.hi: कहते हैं कि दवा जितनी कड़वी हो, रोग पर उतना ही असर करती है।
items.gu: કહેવાય છે કે દવા જેટલી કડવી, તેટલી રોગ પર વધુ અસર કરે.

opts.en: 苦しい = painful (needs the okurigana しい)

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 苦 + い (one kana) = にがい; 苦 + しい = くるしい. Bitter medicine (苦い薬) is the book's example. The saying echoes 良薬は口に苦し.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 苦い薬ほど病に効くといいます。
items.qr: Nigai kusuri hodo yamai ni kiku to iimasu.
items.en: (same sentence) … the better it works on illness.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … रोग पर उतना ही असर करती है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … રોગ પર વધુ અસર કરે.

opts.en: 美容 = beauty care — not a reading of 病

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 病 standing alone, with no okurigana, is the kun reading やまい (重い病). The on-reading びょう only appears inside compounds such as 病気 or 病院.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 首相は焦って、前言を覆した。
items.qr: Shushou wa asette, zengen o kutsugaeshita.
items.en: In a panic, the prime minister went back on what he had said.
items.hi: हड़बड़ी में प्रधानमंत्री ने अपनी पिछली बात पलट दी।
items.gu: ઉતાવળમાં વડાપ્રધાને પોતાની અગાઉની વાત ફેરવી નાખી.

opts.en: not a verb form (慌てる → あわてて)
焦る = to panic, be hasty

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 焦 + る = あせる (時間がなくて焦る). 焦 + がれる would be こがれる. Option 1 matches the meaning (慌てる, "be flustered") but is not a reading of 焦, and the form is wrong anyway.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 首相は焦って、前言を覆した。
items.qr: Shushou wa asette, zengen o kutsugaeshita.
items.en: (same sentence) … reversed his earlier statement.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … अपनी पिछली बात पलट दी।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … અગાઉની વાત ફેરવી નાખી.

opts.en: 翻した = turned over, retracted — a different kanji

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 覆 + す = くつがえす (真実を覆す). 覆 + う would be おおう. Watch option 1: 前言を翻す (ひるがえす) is also a real phrase with almost the same meaning, but it is written with 翻, not 覆, so it is not the reading of the kanji shown.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 息子は父の老いた手にそっと触れた。
items.qr: Musuko wa chichi no oita te ni sotto fureta.
items.en: The son gently touched his father's aged hand.
items.hi: बेटे ने पिता के बूढ़े हाथ को धीरे से छुआ।
items.gu: દીકરાએ પિતાના વૃદ્ધ હાથને હળવેથી સ્પર્શ કર્યો.

opts.en: not a word (老ける → ふけた)
not a word (ろう is the on-reading)

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) The okurigana is いた, so the verb is 老いる (おいる) → 老いた. 老ける would be written 老けた (ふけた); options 1 and 3 mix the two verbs.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 息子は父の老いた手にそっと触れた。
items.qr: Musuko wa chichi no oita te ni sotto fureta.
items.en: (same sentence) … gently touched his father's hand.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … हाथ को धीरे से छुआ।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … હાથને હળવેથી સ્પર્શ કર્યો.

opts.en: 触れた read as "could touch" (potential of 触る) — does not fit
opts.hi: छू सका (触る का संभाव्य रूप) — अर्थ नहीं बैठता
opts.gu: અડી શક્યો (触るનું શક્યરૂપ) — અર્થ બેસતો નથી

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 〜にそっと触れる = "touch gently", like 髪が肩に触れる in the list. さわれた is grammatically possible as the potential of 触る, but "the son was able to touch" does not fit a description of one gentle action.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 海があれているときは、もぐることができない。
items.qr: Umi ga arete iru toki wa, moguru koto ga dekinai.
items.en: You can't dive when the sea is rough.
items.hi: जब समुद्र में तूफ़ान हो, तब गोता नहीं लगाया जा सकता।
items.gu: દરિયો તોફાની હોય ત્યારે ડૂબકી મારી શકાતી નથી.

opts.en: not a standard form (跳ねる = はねる)

items.why: Answer 3 (key 問題Ⅱ ①, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 海が荒れる = "the sea is rough"; the list has 手が荒れる. 荒 + れる = あれる, 荒 + い = あらい.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 海があれているときは、もぐることができない。
items.qr: Umi ga arete iru toki wa, moguru koto ga dekinai.
items.en: (same sentence) … you can't dive.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … गोता नहीं लगाया जा सकता।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … ડૂબકી મારી શકાતી નથી.

opts.en: not a standard form (隠れる = かくれる)
not a standard form (沈む = しずむ)

items.why: Answer 1 (key 問題Ⅱ ②, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 水に潜る (もぐる) is in the list; 潜 + む would be ひそむ (lurk). 沈 matches the "go under water" meaning but is never read もぐる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: あの国は天然資源にとんでいるが、開発がおくれている。
items.qr: Ano kuni wa tennen shigen ni tonde iru ga, kaihatsu ga okurete iru.
items.en: That country is rich in natural resources, but its development is lagging behind.
items.hi: वह देश प्राकृतिक संसाधनों से भरपूर है, लेकिन उसका विकास पिछड़ा हुआ है।
items.gu: તે દેશ કુદરતી સંસાધનોથી સમૃદ્ધ છે, પણ તેનો વિકાસ પાછળ છે.

opts.en: not a standard form (豊か = ゆたか)

items.why: Answer 2 (key 問題Ⅱ ③, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 〜に富む = "rich in ~" (自然に富む in the list). 豊 and 財 match the idea of wealth, and 恵まれる ("be blessed with") is close in meaning, but only 富 is read と(む).
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: あの国は天然資源にとんでいるが、開発がおくれている。
items.qr: Ano kuni wa tennen shigen ni tonde iru ga, kaihatsu ga okurete iru.
items.en: (same sentence) … its development is lagging behind.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … उसका विकास पिछड़ा हुआ है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … તેનો વિકાસ પાછળ છે.

opts.en: being able to send (potential of 送る) — wrong meaning
not a standard form (栄える = さかえる)

items.why: Answer 2 (key 問題Ⅱ ④, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 開発が遅れる = "development lags" (授業に遅れる in the list). 送れて sounds identical, which makes it the real trap; read the meaning, not just the sound.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 子どもをかかえた母親の顔から汗がしたたっている。
items.qr: Kodomo o kakaeta hahaoya no kao kara ase ga shitatatte iru.
items.en: Sweat is dripping from the face of the mother carrying her child.
items.hi: बच्चे को गोद में उठाए माँ के चेहरे से पसीना टपक रहा है।
items.gu: બાળકને તેડીને ઊભેલી માતાના ચહેરા પરથી પરસેવો ટપકી રહ્યો છે.

opts.en: not a standard form (拵える = こしらえる)

items.why: Answer 3 (key 問題Ⅱ ⑤, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 抱 + える = かかえる (荷物を抱える). 抱 + く would be だく or いだく. Options 1–2 are all "carrying" kanji, but none is read かかえる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 子どもをかかえた母親の顔から汗がしたたっている。
items.qr: Kodomo o kakaeta hahaoya no kao kara ase ga shitatatte iru.
items.en: (same sentence) … sweat is dripping.
items.hi: (वही वाक्य) … पसीना टपक रहा है।
items.gu: (એ જ વાક્ય) … પરસેવો ટપકી રહ્યો છે.

opts.en: not a standard form (落ちて = おちて)
not a standard form (溢れて = あふれて)

items.why: Answer 1 (key 問題Ⅱ ⑥, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 滴 + る = したたる (血が滴る in the list); 滴 alone is しずく (a drop). The other kanji are all about liquid moving, but none is read したたる.
items.unit: I-2 訓読みが複数あるもの ④

items.q: 政府は貿易まさつの解消を迫られている。
items.qr: Seifu wa boueki masatsu no kaishou o semararete iru.
items.en: The government is under pressure to resolve the trade friction.
items.hi: सरकार पर व्यापार-विवाद (घर्षण) सुलझाने का दबाव है।
items.gu: સરકાર પર વેપાર-ઘર્ષણ ઉકેલવાનું દબાણ છે.

opts.t: 手術はますいなしに行われた。→ 麻酔
opts.r: Shujutsu wa masui nashi ni okonawareta.
opts.en: The operation was done without anaesthesia (麻酔).
opts.hi: ऑपरेशन बिना बेहोशी की दवा के किया गया।

opts.t: この包丁はけんますればもっと切れる。→ 研磨
opts.r: Kono houchou wa kenma sureba motto kireru.
opts.en: This knife will cut better if you sharpen (研磨) it.
opts.hi: इस चाकू पर धार लगाओ तो और अच्छा काटेगा।
opts.gu: આ છરીને ધાર કાઢો તો વધુ સારું કાપશે.

opts.t: 彼はびょうまに冒されながらも絵を描き続けた。→ 病魔
opts.r: Kare wa byouma ni okasarenagara mo e o kakitsuzuketa.
opts.en: Even while ravaged by illness (病魔), he kept painting.
opts.hi: बीमारी से ग्रस्त होते हुए भी वह चित्र बनाता रहा।
opts.gu: બીમારીથી ઘેરાયેલો હોવા છતાં તે ચિત્રો દોરતો રહ્યો.

opts.t: ニューヨークにはまてんろうが林立している。→ 摩天楼
opts.r: Nyuuyooku ni wa matenrou ga ringitsu shite iru.
opts.en: New York is crowded with skyscrapers (摩天楼).
opts.hi: न्यूयॉर्क में गगनचुंबी इमारतों की भरमार है।

items.why: Answer 4 (book's 解き方, p.28). Book's 解き方 (paraphrased): the options are 1 麻酔, 2 研磨, 3 病魔, 4 摩天楼; the question word is 摩擦, so the answer is 4. (added, not in book) All four ま are written with kanji built on 麻; only the bottom part changes: 手 (rub) in 摩, 石 (stone, grind) in 磨, 鬼 (demon) in 魔.
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: はくしゅで新入生を迎えた。
items.qr: Hakushu de shinnyuusei o mukaeta.
items.en: We welcomed the new students with applause.
items.hi: हमने तालियों से नए विद्यार्थियों का स्वागत किया।
items.gu: અમે તાળીઓથી નવા વિદ્યાર્થીઓનું સ્વાગત કર્યું.

opts.t: 彼らの実力ははくちゅうしている。→ 伯仲
opts.r: Karera no jitsuryoku wa hakuchuu shite iru.
opts.en: Their abilities are evenly matched (伯仲).

opts.t: 山の上のホテルにしゅくはくした。→ 宿泊
opts.r: Yama no ue no hoteru ni shukuhaku shita.
opts.en: I stayed (宿泊) at a hotel on the mountain.
opts.hi: मैं पहाड़ के ऊपर वाले होटल में ठहरा।

opts.t: 試合に臨む選手たちのきはくに圧倒される。→ 気迫
opts.r: Shiai ni nozomu senshutachi no kihaku ni attou sareru.
opts.en: I am overwhelmed by the fighting spirit (気迫) of the players facing the match.
opts.hi: मैच के लिए उतरे खिलाड़ियों के जोश से मैं अभिभूत हूँ।
opts.gu: મૅચ માટે ઊતરેલા ખેલાડીઓના જુસ્સાથી હું અભિભૂત છું.

opts.t: スポーツをした後、みゃくはくを測る。→ 脈拍
opts.r: Supootsu o shita ato, myakuhaku o hakaru.
opts.en: After exercise, I measure my pulse (脈拍).
opts.hi: खेलकूद के बाद मैं अपनी नब्ज़ नापता हूँ।
opts.gu: રમતગમત પછી હું મારી નાડી માપું છું.

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 拍手 and 脈拍 share 拍 (扌, a hand beating). All five ハク kanji in the list share 白; 伯 (亻), 泊 (氵) and 迫 (辶) only change the left or bottom part.
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: この雑誌は会員にのみ送付していて、しはんしていません。
items.qr: Kono zasshi wa kaiin ni nomi soufu shite ite, shihan shite imasen.
items.en: This magazine is sent only to members and is not sold in shops.
items.hi: यह पत्रिका केवल सदस्यों को भेजी जाती है, बाज़ार में नहीं बिकती।
items.gu: આ સામયિક ફક્ત સભ્યોને મોકલાય છે, બજારમાં વેચાતું નથી.

opts.t: ここに車を止めるのはいはんです。→ 違反
opts.r: Koko ni kuruma o tomeru no wa ihan desu.
opts.en: Parking here is a violation (違反).
opts.hi: यहाँ गाड़ी खड़ी करना नियम का उल्लंघन है।
opts.gu: અહીં ગાડી પાર્ક કરવી નિયમભંગ છે.

opts.t: トラックはとうはん車線を走ってください。→ 登坂
opts.r: Torakku wa touhan shasen o hashitte kudasai.
opts.en: Trucks, please use the climbing lane (登坂車線).
opts.hi: ट्रक चढ़ाई वाली लेन में चलें।

opts.t: はんがで年賀状をつくることにした。→ 版画
opts.r: Hanga de nengajou o tsukuru koto ni shita.
opts.en: I decided to make my New Year cards with woodblock prints (版画).
opts.hi: मैंने नववर्ष-कार्ड काष्ठ-छापे से बनाने का निश्चय किया।
opts.gu: મેં નવા વર્ષનાં કાર્ડ કાષ્ઠ-છાપથી બનાવવાનું નક્કી કર્યું.

opts.t: 姉はデパートのはんばい員をしている。→ 販売
opts.r: Ane wa depaato no hanbaiin o shite iru.
opts.en: My older sister works as a sales clerk (販売員) at a department store.
opts.hi: मेरी बड़ी बहन डिपार्टमेंट स्टोर में सेल्सवुमन है।
opts.gu: મારી મોટી બહેન ડિપાર્ટમેન્ટ સ્ટોરમાં સેલ્સવુમન છે.

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 市販 ("sold on the market") and 販売 share 販, with 貝 (shell = money) for trade. 違反 (反), 登坂 (坂, earth) and 版画 (版, board) are the look-alikes.
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 意見が分かれ、会議はけんあくなムードになった。
items.qr: Iken ga wakare, kaigi wa ken'aku na muudo ni natta.
items.en: Opinions split and the meeting turned hostile.
items.hi: राय बँट गई और बैठक का माहौल तनावपूर्ण हो गया।
items.gu: મત વહેંચાઈ ગયા અને બેઠકનું વાતાવરણ તંગ બની ગયું.

opts.t: 新しい薬品の臨床じっけんを行った。→ 実験
opts.r: Atarashii yakuhin no rinshou jikken o okonatta.
opts.en: They carried out clinical trials (臨床実験) of the new drug.
opts.hi: नई दवा का क्लिनिकल परीक्षण किया गया।

opts.t: シーズン前に暖房器具のてんけんをする。→ 点検
opts.r: Shiizun mae ni danbou kigu no tenken o suru.
opts.en: Before the season, I check (点検) the heaters.
opts.hi: मौसम से पहले हीटरों की जाँच करता हूँ।
opts.gu: સીઝન પહેલાં હીટરોની તપાસ કરું છું.

opts.t: 学生たちはしんけんな表情でテストを受けていた。→ 真剣
opts.r: Gakuseitachi wa shinken na hyoujou de tesuto o ukete ita.
opts.en: The students were taking the test with serious (真剣) faces.
opts.hi: विद्यार्थी गंभीर चेहरों के साथ परीक्षा दे रहे थे।
opts.gu: વિદ્યાર્થીઓ ગંભીર ચહેરે પરીક્ષા આપી રહ્યા હતા.

opts.t: 海外旅行に行くのでほけんに入っておく。→ 保険
opts.r: Kaigai ryokou ni iku node hoken ni haitte oku.
opts.en: I'm going abroad, so I'll take out insurance (保険).
opts.hi: विदेश यात्रा पर जा रहा हूँ, इसलिए बीमा करा लेता हूँ।
opts.gu: વિદેશ પ્રવાસે જાઉં છું, એટલે વીમો લઈ લઉં છું.

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 険悪 and 保険 share 険 (阝, a steep hill → danger; insurance protects against danger). Options 1–3 use 験 (馬), 検 (木) and 剣 (刂), all built on the same right-hand part.
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 税金を払うのはみんなのぎむです。
items.qr: Zeikin o harau no wa minna no gimu desu.
items.en: Paying taxes is everyone's duty.
items.hi: कर चुकाना सबका कर्तव्य है।
items.gu: કર ભરવો સૌની ફરજ છે.

opts.t: 今日のぎだいは来年度の予算についてです。→ 議題
opts.r: Kyou no gidai wa rainendo no yosan ni tsuite desu.
opts.en: Today's agenda item (議題) is next year's budget.
opts.hi: आज का विषय अगले वर्ष का बजट है।
opts.gu: આજનો વિષય આવતા વર્ષનું બજેટ છે.

opts.t: 彼はせいぎ感からタバコを吸っている高校生に注意した。→ 正義
opts.r: Kare wa seigikan kara tabako o sutte iru koukousei ni chuui shita.
opts.en: Out of a sense of justice (正義感), he warned the high-school students who were smoking.
opts.hi: न्याय-भावना से उसने सिगरेट पी रहे हाई-स्कूल छात्रों को टोका।
opts.gu: ન્યાયની ભાવનાથી તેણે સિગારેટ પીતા હાઈસ્કૂલના વિદ્યાર્થીઓને ટોક્યા.

opts.t: この家のりゅうぎなので従ってください。→ 流儀
opts.r: Kono ie no ryuugi na node shitagatte kudasai.
opts.en: This is the way (流儀) of this house, so please follow it.
opts.hi: यह इस घर का तौर-तरीक़ा है, इसलिए इसका पालन करें।
opts.gu: આ આ ઘરની રીત છે, એટલે તેનું પાલન કરો.

opts.t: こどもがぎせいになる事件が増えている。→ 犠牲
opts.r: Kodomo ga gisei ni naru jiken ga fuete iru.
opts.en: Incidents in which children become victims (犠牲) are increasing.
opts.hi: बच्चों के शिकार बनने की घटनाएँ बढ़ रही हैं।
opts.gu: બાળકો ભોગ બને તેવી ઘટનાઓ વધી રહી છે.

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 義務 and 正義 use the bare 義. 議 adds 言, 儀 adds 亻, 犠 adds 牛. A quick test: if the word is about talking it is 議; about manners or ceremony, 儀; about sacrifice, 犠.
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 共同こうにゅうで安く野菜を買っている。
items.qr: Kyoudou kounyuu de yasuku yasai o katte iru.
items.en: We buy vegetables cheaply through group purchasing.
items.hi: हम सामूहिक ख़रीद से सस्ती सब्ज़ियाँ ख़रीदते हैं।
items.gu: અમે સામૂહિક ખરીદીથી સસ્તાં શાકભાજી ખરીદીએ છીએ.

opts.t: 家のそっこうを掃除する。→ 側溝
opts.r: Ie no sokkou o souji suru.
opts.en: I clean the gutter (側溝) by the house.
opts.hi: मैं घर के किनारे की नाली साफ़ करता हूँ।
opts.gu: હું ઘર બાજુની ગટર સાફ કરું છું.

opts.t: 大学でこうしとして教えている。→ 講師
opts.r: Daigaku de koushi to shite oshiete iru.
opts.en: I teach at a university as a lecturer (講師).
opts.hi: मैं विश्वविद्यालय में व्याख्याता के रूप में पढ़ाता हूँ।
opts.gu: હું યુનિવર્સિટીમાં વ્યાખ્યાતા તરીકે ભણાવું છું.

opts.t: この雑誌を定期こうどくしています。→ 購読
opts.r: Kono zasshi o teiki koudoku shite imasu.
opts.en: I have a regular subscription (定期購読) to this magazine.
opts.hi: मैं इस पत्रिका का नियमित ग्राहक हूँ।
opts.gu: હું આ સામયિકનો નિયમિત ગ્રાહક છું.

opts.t: この作文はこうせいが悪い。→ 構成
opts.r: Kono sakubun wa kousei ga warui.
opts.en: This essay is badly structured (構成).
opts.hi: इस निबंध की संरचना ख़राब है।

items.why: Answer 3 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 購入 and 購読 share 購 (貝 = money: buying). The right part 冓 is shared by all four; the left part tells you the meaning: 氵 water (溝), 言 speech (講), 木 wood/structure (構).
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 子どものせいちょうを見るのが楽しみだ。
items.qr: Kodomo no seichou o miru no ga tanoshimi da.
items.en: I look forward to watching my children grow.
items.hi: बच्चों को बड़ा होते देखना मुझे अच्छा लगता है।
items.gu: બાળકોને મોટાં થતાં જોવાનો મને આનંદ છે.

opts.t: 彼のちょうしょを伸ばしてやりたい。→ 長所
opts.r: Kare no chousho o nobashite yaritai.
opts.en: I want to develop his strong points (長所).
opts.hi: मैं उसकी ख़ूबियों को निखारना चाहता हूँ।
opts.gu: હું તેની ખૂબીઓ વિકસાવવા માગું છું.

opts.t: 宇宙はどんどんぼうちょうしているらしい。→ 膨張・膨脹
opts.r: Uchuu wa dondon bouchou shite iru rashii.
opts.en: The universe seems to be expanding (膨張) steadily.
opts.hi: ब्रह्मांड लगातार फैल रहा है, ऐसा लगता है।
opts.gu: બ્રહ્માંડ સતત વિસ્તરી રહ્યું હોય એવું લાગે છે.

opts.t: 駅前のスーパーは売り場をかくちょうした。→ 拡張
opts.r: Ekimae no suupaa wa uriba o kakuchou shita.
opts.en: The supermarket by the station expanded (拡張) its sales floor.
opts.hi: स्टेशन के पास वाले सुपरमार्केट ने अपना बिक्री-क्षेत्र बढ़ाया।

opts.t: 予定をてちょうに書き込んでおく。→ 手帳
opts.r: Yotei o techou ni kakikonde oku.
opts.en: I write my plans in my pocket diary (手帳).
opts.hi: मैं अपने कार्यक्रम डायरी में लिख लेता हूँ।
opts.gu: હું મારા કાર્યક્રમ ડાયરીમાં લખી રાખું છું.

items.why: Answer 1 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 成長 and 長所 share the bare 長. The others add a part: 脹/張 (月 body or 弓 bow — "stretching, swelling"; 膨張 is the usual spelling today, the book lists 膨脹), 帳 (巾 cloth — a notebook).
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ①

items.q: 恋人のれいたんな態度にショックを受けた。
items.qr: Koibito no reitan na taido ni shokku o uketa.
items.en: I was shocked by my partner's cold attitude.
items.hi: प्रेमी के रूखे व्यवहार से मुझे झटका लगा।
items.gu: પ્રેમીના રૂક્ષ વર્તનથી મને આઘાત લાગ્યો.

opts.t: コーチのごうれいに合わせて選手達は声を出しランニングを続けた。→ 号令
opts.r: Koochi no gourei ni awasete senshutachi wa koe o dashi ranningu o tsuzuketa.
opts.en: Keeping time with the coach's commands (号令), the players kept running and calling out.
opts.hi: कोच के आदेश के साथ खिलाड़ी आवाज़ लगाते हुए दौड़ते रहे।
opts.gu: કોચના હુકમ સાથે ખેલાડીઓ અવાજ કાઢતાં દોડતા રહ્યા.

opts.t: この車はかんれい地に適応した仕様になっています。→ 寒冷
opts.r: Kono kuruma wa kanreichi ni tekiou shita shiyou ni natte imasu.
opts.en: This car is built for cold regions (寒冷地).
opts.hi: यह कार ठंडे इलाक़ों के अनुकूल बनाई गई है।
opts.gu: આ કાર ઠંડા પ્રદેશોને અનુકૂળ બનાવેલી છે.

opts.t: このあたりはれいさい企業が軒を並べている地区だ。→ 零細
opts.r: Kono atari wa reisai kigyou ga noki o narabete iru chiku da.
opts.en: This is a district lined with very small businesses (零細企業).
opts.hi: यह इलाक़ा छोटे-छोटे उद्यमों से भरा है।
opts.gu: આ વિસ્તાર નાના-નાના ઉદ્યોગોથી ભરેલો છે.

opts.t: こうれいの人たちを対象としたコンピュータ教室が開かれている。→ 高齢
opts.r: Kourei no hitotachi o taishou to shita konpyuuta kyoushitsu ga hirakarete iru.
opts.en: Computer classes for elderly (高齢) people are being held.
opts.hi: बुज़ुर्गों के लिए कंप्यूटर कक्षाएँ चल रही हैं।
opts.gu: વડીલો માટે કમ્પ્યૂટર વર્ગો ચાલે છે.

items.why: Answer 2 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 冷淡 and 寒冷 share 冷 (冫 ice → cold). 号令 is the bare 令, 零細 adds 雨, 高齢 adds 歯 — all built on 令 and all read れい.
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 多額の飲食費をせいきゅうされた。
items.qr: Tagaku no inshokuhi o seikyuu sareta.
items.en: I was billed a large amount for food and drink.
items.hi: मुझसे खाने-पीने का भारी बिल माँगा गया।
items.gu: મારી પાસેથી ખાણી-પીણીનું મોટું બિલ માગવામાં આવ્યું.

opts.t: 運動会はすばらしいせいてんに恵まれた。→ 晴天
opts.r: Undoukai wa subarashii seiten ni megumareta.
opts.en: Sports day was blessed with wonderful weather (晴天).
opts.hi: खेल-दिवस पर शानदार साफ़ मौसम मिला।
opts.gu: રમતોત્સવના દિવસે સરસ ચોખ્ખું હવામાન મળ્યું.

opts.t: ビルのせいそうアルバイトをしている。→ 清掃
opts.r: Biru no seisou arubaito o shite iru.
opts.en: I have a part-time job cleaning (清掃) buildings.
opts.hi: मैं इमारतों की सफ़ाई का पार्ट-टाइम काम करता हूँ।
opts.gu: હું ઇમારતોની સફાઈનું પાર્ટ-ટાઇમ કામ કરું છું.

opts.t: 祖父母はかんせいな住宅地に住んでいる。→ 閑静
opts.r: Sofubo wa kansei na juutakuchi ni sunde iru.
opts.en: My grandparents live in a quiet (閑静) residential area.
opts.hi: मेरे दादा-दादी एक शांत आवासीय इलाक़े में रहते हैं।
opts.gu: મારાં દાદા-દાદી શાંત રહેણાક વિસ્તારમાં રહે છે.

opts.t: 一時帰国するので再入国許可書をしんせいする。→ 申請
opts.r: Ichiji kikoku suru node sainyuukoku kyokasho o shinsei suru.
opts.en: I'm going home for a while, so I'll apply (申請) for a re-entry permit.
opts.hi: कुछ समय के लिए देश जा रहा हूँ, इसलिए पुनः-प्रवेश परमिट का आवेदन करूँगा।
opts.gu: થોડા સમય માટે દેશ જાઉં છું, એટલે પુનઃપ્રવેશ પરમિટની અરજી કરીશ.

items.why: Answer 4 (book key, 別冊 p.2). (added, not in book) 請求 and 申請 share 請 (言 = speech: asking for something). 晴 (日 sun), 清 (氵 water) and 静 (争) are the look-alikes; the six セイ kanji all contain 青.
items.unit: II-1 形が似ていて読み方が同じもの ②

items.q: 新しいレストランがアルバイトをぼしゅうしている。
items.qr: Atarashii resutoran ga arubaito o boshuu shite iru.
items.en: The new restaurant is hiring part-timers.
items.hi: नया रेस्टोरेंट पार्ट-टाइम कर्मचारियों की भर्ती कर रहा है।
items.gu: નવી રેસ્ટોરન્ટ પાર્ટ-ટાઇમ કર્મચારીઓની ભરતી કરે છે.

opts.t: お世話になった人におせいぼを送った。→ 歳暮
opts.r: Osewa ni natta hito ni oseibo o okutta.
opts.en: I sent a year-end gift (お歳暮) to someone who has helped me.
opts.hi: जिसने मेरी मदद की, उसे साल के अंत का उपहार भेजा।
opts.gu: જેમણે મદદ કરી, તેમને વર્ષના અંતની ભેટ મોકલી.

opts.t: 中学校の教師にほのかなしぼの気持ちを抱く。→ 思慕
